server.signOut: Button that ends this computer's session on the collaboration server. It does not quit the app.
server.remove: Button that removes the server from this computer's list. Nothing is deleted on the server.

devices.current: Badge on the row for the computer the person is using right now

status.info: Status word for a check that neither passed nor failed but has something worth knowing

webSocket.label: Name of the check for the always-open connection that carries live edits. Avoid technical words such as WebSocket.

addServer.addressPlaceholder: Example server address shown in an empty field. Keep it exactly as written.
addServer.setupDescription: The setup code is a one-time code the server prints in its log the first time it starts
addServer.continueWith: {{provider}} is the name of a sign-in service, such as GitHub or University login

errors.not_admitted: Shown when the server's admin has not allowed this person to sign in. Keep it short and calm.
errors.server_changed: Shown when the saved server address now belongs to a different server. Oleafly refused to talk to it. Keep the advice to remove and re-add only if trusted.
errors.duplicate_server: Shown when an address the person adds answers as a server that is already in their list under a different address.
errors.device_in_use: "Computer account" means the person's user account on the operating system, not their account on the server. Oleafly's device key belongs to that operating-system account, so two people sharing it cannot both sign in.

roles.admin: Server role with full control of the server
roles.maintainer: Server role that can manage members but cannot change server settings
roles.member: Server role for a regular person on the server
roles.guest: Server role for someone from outside who can only open projects shared with them

tabs.allowlist: Tab with the list of people allowed to sign in, by email address or sign-in name

match.login: A user name on a sign-in service, such as a GitHub username

allowlist.emailPlaceholder: Example email address shown in an empty field. Keep example.edu.
allowlist.loginPlaceholder: Example GitHub username shown in an empty field. Keep it exactly as written.

domains.domainPlaceholder: Example domain shown in an empty field. Keep it exactly as written.

log.server: Shown in place of a person's name when the server itself did something

kinds.signIn: Security log entry. The person named just before it signed in.
kinds.signInRefused: Security log entry. The person named just before it tried to sign in and the server said no.
kinds.refreshReuseDetected: Security log entry. A session token was used twice, which can mean it was stolen, so the server signed that device out.
kinds.unknown: Security log entry of a kind this version of the app does not know yet. Keep it neutral.

members.devices: Button on a member's row that shows the computers signed in with that person's account
